title: Earth's Impenetrable Radiation Barrier Was Breached

sentences.text: Earth has an invisible wall that scientists said nothing could cross.
Then in 2024, the Sun proved them wrong.
Giant belts of charged particles surround our planet.
Deadly killer electrons stopped at a razor sharp edge, three Earth radii out.
Scientists called it the impenetrable barrier.
In May 2024, a G5 superstorm hit Earth.
It crushed our protective plasma cloud, and let strange waves that sound like birdsong take over.
Japan's Arase satellite watched electrons inside the barrier get accelerated to millions of electron volts.
Five thousand times more than before.
The wall was breached from within.
The extra radiation lasted for months, and it changes how we protect satellites and astronauts.
